线性增减场景总进光量 (EV): Scale the scene's total light linearly (EV)
自动曝光（AU）：按 18% 中灰测光建议设置曝光，不改动其他参数: Auto exposure (AU): apply the 18% grey metering suggestion to exposure only
高光强光区域场景线性滚降压缩或提亮: Compress (roll off) or lift the highlight region in scene-linear
深层暗部阶调平滑提亮或下压，保护纯黑底阶: Lift or deepen the deep-shadow tones while keeping true black
黑场标定：向左扣除片基灰雾、压实纯黑，向右抬高黑位。作用在 LUT 之后的显示域: Black-point calibration: left removes base fog and crushes to true black, right raises the black level. Applied in display space, after the LUT.
调节场景相关色温 (CCT)，左偏冷蓝，右偏暖黄: Scene correlated colour temperature (CCT); left is cooler, right is warmer
微调洋红与绿色光色平衡 (Tint)，左偏品红，右偏绿色: Fine-tune the magenta/green balance; left is magenta, right is green
底片画幅尺寸，影响银盐晶体与微米级弥散圈物理相对尺度: Negative format size; sets the physical scale of the silver crystals and the micron-level circle of confusion
